description: Auto-loads phi-RLM evolution state at session start

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json, os; state = json.load(open('evolution_state.json')) if os.path.exists('evolution_state.json') else {}; print(json.dumps({'generation': state.get('generation', 0), 'fitness': round(state.get('fitness', 0), 4), 'best_strategy': max(state.get('chunk_strategy_scores', {'default': 0}), key=state.get('chunk_strategy_scores', {'default': 0}).get) if state.get('chunk_strategy_scores') else 'diversity', 'agent_performance': state.get('agent_performance', {})}))"
